<script>
(() => {
  const element = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const set = (node, name, value) => node.setAttribute(name, value);
  const numbers = path => path.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g).map(Number);
  const lerp = (a, b, p) => a + (b - a) * p;
  const blend = (a, b, p) => a.map((value, i) => lerp(value, b[i], p));

  function cubicPath(points) {
    let d = `M${points[0]} ${points[1]}`;
    for (let i = 2; i < points.length; i += 6) {
      d += `C${points.slice(i, i + 6).join(" ")}`;
    }
    return d + "Z";
  }

  const body = element("chick-outline");
  const head = element("head");
  const shoulderLight = element("shoulder-light-shape");
  const belly = element("belly");
  const leftWing = element("left-wing-outline");
  const rightWing = element("right-wing-outline");
  const leftHand = element("left-hand");
  const rightHand = element("right-hand");
  const rightTip = element("right-hand-outline");
  const leftHighlight = element("left-wing-highlight");
  const rightHighlight = element("right-wing-highlight");
  const rightShade = element("right-wing-fold-shading");
  const rightOpenDetail = element("right-hand-open-detail");
  const rightFoldDetail = element("right-hand-fold-detail");
  const bodyPoints = numbers(body.getAttribute("d"));
  const openRightTip = numbers(rightTip.getAttribute("d"));
  const foldedRightTip = numbers("M196 89C195 82 200 74 202 68C204 62 208 60 213 63C216 65 216 69 222 70C227 72 229 78 229 83C229 90 221 96 213 99C207 102 199 105 196 96Z");

  const times = [0, 160, 340, 500, 680, 840, 1020, 1180, 1200];
  const leftShapes = [
    leftWing.getAttribute("d"),
    "M10 65C16 60 23 66 26 79C30 94 48 89 74 74C66 92 51 124 37 134C26 143 12 139 8 129C3 120 5 106 6 94C6 82 5 72 10 65Z",
    "M48 96C55 89 69 92 75 103C81 115 79 132 75 146C72 161 65 169 55 169C44 170 37 160 35 149C33 138 37 126 40 116C42 106 43 101 48 96Z",
    "M14 101C22 94 31 103 35 111C45 111 59 99 74 86C67 108 60 140 47 158C39 170 26 171 18 164C11 157 10 145 11 131C10 119 9 108 14 101Z",
    "M14 96C20 88 30 96 33 105C43 108 59 92 74 79C66 102 58 130 47 147C40 160 29 166 22 158C16 152 14 140 13 127C10 114 9 103 14 96Z",
    "M52 86C59 79 71 81 77 90C84 102 83 120 79 135C76 151 68 160 56 161C45 163 36 154 35 141C33 130 37 116 42 106C46 96 47 91 52 86Z",
    "M12 83C18 76 27 81 31 92C38 100 54 90 73 77C66 98 53 128 44 142C35 155 22 156 14 148C8 142 7 130 8 116C8 103 6 91 12 83Z",
    "M34 107C42 101 53 106 59 115C66 113 69 107 77 101C76 122 74 147 65 162C59 173 49 180 40 174C31 169 29 159 29 146C27 132 28 115 34 107Z"
  ].map(numbers);

  const rightShapes = [
    rightWing.getAttribute("d"),
    "M145 94C151 82 162 83 171 94C178 100 177 93 181 79C193 89 208 105 212 120C217 137 210 153 196 161C184 169 169 161 158 152C146 142 135 112 145 94Z",
    "M199 91C205 83 215 86 219 96C223 107 229 119 232 131C236 143 231 153 221 156C211 162 202 156 197 146C192 136 191 123 192 111C192 101 195 95 199 91Z",
    "M174 114C181 106 190 105 197 114C205 108 208 106 211 112C220 126 223 140 220 154C218 168 209 180 198 183C185 187 175 176 170 164C165 151 166 124 174 114Z",
    "M163 103C170 92 183 93 190 104C198 110 199 105 199 100C211 113 220 128 221 140C223 152 216 165 205 171C192 178 178 170 169 161C158 152 155 116 163 103Z",
    "M200 92C206 85 216 87 219 97C223 106 228 119 230 131C233 142 227 153 218 157C207 161 200 155 195 145C190 134 191 121 192 110C193 101 195 96 200 92Z",
    "M160 106C167 94 179 99 187 109C194 111 197 105 196 100C208 112 216 124 217 138C219 149 213 163 202 173C190 181 177 178 167 167C155 156 149 124 160 106Z",
    "M195 106C203 99 214 101 220 112C225 123 231 135 233 145C235 158 229 167 218 172C208 178 197 173 191 163C184 154 181 139 183 127C185 117 190 110 195 106Z"
  ].map(numbers);

  // The head coordinates are offsets and tilt. Hand coordinates give center, angle and scale.
  const headPoses = [
    [0, 0, 0], [1, 0.5, .19], [2, 4, 0], [-.5, 10.5, .12],
    [1.5, 5.5, .12], [0, 2.5, .025], [-.5, 5.5, .21], [1, 10, .05]
  ];
  const leftHandPoses = [
    [71, 93, 0, 1, 1], [16, 77, 8, .62, 1.08],
    [59, 107, -8, 1.1, 1], [24, 114, -15, .89, 1.08],
    [23, 106, -11, .78, 1.02], [63, 96, -2, 1.02, 1],
    [21, 96, 1, .79, 1.12], [46, 119, -12, 1.02, 1.04]
  ];
  const rightHandPoses = [
    [212, 82, 0, 1, 1], [156, 98, -3, 1.04, 1],
    [211, 94, 3, .97, 1.04], [187, 124, 21, 1.09, 1],
    [176, 109, 5, 1.07, 1.02], [211, 94, 1, .94, .98],
    [171, 114, -1, 1.1, 1.02], [208, 112, 6, 1.04, 1.11]
  ];
  const rightFold = [0, 1, 0, .83, 1, 0, 1, .12];
  const bellyPoses = [[0, 0], [-6, 2], [0, 6], [-3, 12], [-5, 7], [0, 3], [-4, 9], [0, 11]];

  function handTransform(pose, centerX, centerY) {
    const [x, y, angle, sx, sy] = pose;
    return `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${sx} ${sy}) translate(${-centerX} ${-centerY})`;
  }

  function render(t) {
    const time = ((t % 1200) + 1200) % 1200;
    let i = 0;
    while (time >= times[i + 1]) i++;
    const next = (i + 1) % leftShapes.length;
    const fraction = (time - times[i]) / (times[i + 1] - times[i]);
    const amount = .5 - .5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * fraction);

    const [headX, headY, tilt] = blend(headPoses[i], headPoses[next], amount);
    set(head, "transform", `matrix(1 ${tilt} 0 1 ${headX} ${headY - 124 * tilt})`);
    set(shoulderLight, "transform", `translate(${headX * .65} ${headY * .54})`);
    const deformedBody = bodyPoints.slice();
    for (let point = 0; point < bodyPoints.length; point += 2) {
      const x = bodyPoints[point];
      const y = bodyPoints[point + 1];
      const weight = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (125 - y) / 67));
      deformedBody[point] = x + headX * weight;
      deformedBody[point + 1] = y + (headY + tilt * (x - 124)) * weight;
    }
    set(body, "d", cubicPath(deformedBody));

    const [bellyX, bellyY] = blend(bellyPoses[i], bellyPoses[next], amount);
    const bellyScale = 1 - bellyY / 150;
    set(belly, "transform", `matrix(1 0 0 ${bellyScale} ${bellyX} ${244 * (1 - bellyScale)})`);

    set(leftWing, "d", cubicPath(blend(leftShapes[i], leftShapes[next], amount)));
    set(rightWing, "d", cubicPath(blend(rightShapes[i], rightShapes[next], amount)));

    const leftPose = blend(leftHandPoses[i], leftHandPoses[next], amount);
    const rightPose = blend(rightHandPoses[i], rightHandPoses[next], amount);
    set(leftHand, "transform", handTransform(leftPose, 71, 93));
    set(rightHand, "transform", handTransform(rightPose, 212, 82));

    const leftReach = Math.max(0, (71 - leftPose[0]) / 55);
    set(leftHighlight, "transform", `translate(${(leftPose[0] - 71) * .65} ${(leftPose[1] - 93) * .8})`);
    set(leftHighlight, "opacity", .65 - .53 * leftReach);
    const fold = lerp(rightFold[i], rightFold[next], amount);
    set(rightTip, "d", cubicPath(blend(openRightTip, foldedRightTip, fold)));
    set(rightOpenDetail, "opacity", 1 - fold);
    set(rightFoldDetail, "opacity", .54 * fold);
    set(rightShade, "opacity", fold * .89);
    set(rightHighlight, "transform", `translate(${(rightPose[0] - 212) * .56} ${(rightPose[1] - 82) * .84})`);
    set(rightHighlight, "opacity", .58 * (1 - fold));
  }

  window.nwb = { render };
  render(0);
})();
